hardware_and_delivery.description: Discussion v2: small-patch-informed step scenario, effective/PEC NISQ envelope, STAR, FT and hybrid; no new dynamics jobs
hardware_and_delivery.trotter_fit_source: Saved square2/square3 plaquette data at tau=1 and r=16,32,64. Rounded coefficient; transfer to other sizes/orderings and tau^3 growth are assumptions.
hardware_and_delivery.nisq_anchor_source: Willow arXiv:2510.26845v1 Table I supplies gates/depth. The sampling overhead and its noise normalization are chosen, not fitted.
hardware_and_delivery.source_description: Rounded packed cultivation reference at p=1e-3; include 2d handoff cycles and a 15-to-1 cleanup stage when required.

budget_search.coefficient_scope: Default: running maximum of measured 3x3 |error| r^2 through the requested time, with 10% margin, to avoid relying on isolated finite-patch cancellations. Pointwise values are retained as a sensitivity. Other sizes and the experimental NISQ ordering remain transfers. No extrapolation beyond measured time nodes. L=2 uses its own measured 2x2 data. The coefficient also covers measured errors at r=ceil(8 tau) and twice that value, avoiding an uncontrolled leading-order approximation at loose precision.
budget_search.search_scope: Best over the declared error-allocation grid and shared source menu, followed by integer-step neighbors. Not a global optimizer or a calibrated source-quality tradeoff.
budget_search.residual_bias_scope: Post-mitigation residual bias reserve, including mismatch and unmodeled SPAM; affordability is assumed, not measured. PEC still assumes the declared invertible channels.

dynamics.scope: Check saved tau=1 allocations before reoptimization; extend finite 4x4 dynamics to tau=2,4. No bulk certificate or tau=8 extrapolation.

patch_sensitivity.scope: Isolate physics calibration with reference delivery and the expanded shared source-count menu held fixed. Added-patch envelope retains the old 3x3 running maximum and covers all measured 4x3/4x4 coefficients through the requested time. L=2 retains its own calibration. Finite-patch sensitivity, not a bulk bound; no interpolation in time or lattice size.

step_selection: Measured coefficients and budget optimization override the legacy fixed-allocation step defaults
